# Intraweb Service Providers

Similar to real-world ISPs, Intraweb Service Providers provide access to the
Intraweb without having to manage BGP, routers, or other things yourself.

An Intraweb ISP will provide you with a tunnel, usually Wireguard, and you will
receive a static IP from the ISP's pool to be used to access the Intraweb.

## Known ISPs

- [vic!ISP](https://isp.itsvic.dev) (operated by [VIC-MNT](/mnts/VIC-MNT)) - provides a WireGuard tunnel for a single /32 IP, free of charge.
